about: HF113: where each launcher keeps the loader's universal jar relative to an ancestor of the instance's mods folder (the roots probed under <ancestor>/<segments>/net/neoforged/neoforge/<build>/ and net/minecraftforge/forge/<build>/). Keyed by the launcher tag modsDirResolver returns on its resolve result; an untagged mods folder probes every distinct row. Relative segments only.
